mission: Serialize material CrownThrive state transitions so canonical records cannot be blindly overwritten, silently deleted, or detached from lineage, rollback, evidence, and continuity.

serialization_contract.canonical_form: JSON keys sorted, compact separators, Unicode preserved
serialization_contract.ledger: append-only JSONL with event hash chaining
serialization_contract.deletion: tombstone by default; no runtime hard-delete API
serialization_contract.restore: new append-only revision derived from preserved live history
serialization_contract.atomicity: temporary file, fsync, atomic replace, POSIX exclusive mutation lock

PentaVersion.purpose: stable subject version lineage and lifecycle

PentaFormat.purpose: canonical format/schema identity and migration safety

PentaSOPs.purpose: SOP revision lineage, review continuity, and supersession

PentaSLAs.purpose: SLA/SLO target lineage and effective-period preservation

integrations.PentaVersion: Every serialized material revision carries independent artifact version and parent revision lineage.
integrations.PentaFormat: Canonical JSON and format adapters prevent format drift from becoming silent state loss.
integrations.PentaSOPs: SOP changes require explicit revision lineage and can be tombstoned/superseded without erasure.
integrations.PentaSLAs: SLA state changes preserve effective values and escalation ownership across revisions.
integrations.PentaScribe: Scribe records become hash-addressed, source-linked institutional events.
integrations.PentaSnapshot: Consumes content-addressed snapshots as recovery baselines.
integrations.PentaRollback: Restores by appending a new revision from preserved history rather than rewriting history.
integrations.PentaLiency: Consumes integrity and continuity failures as hardening/remediation evidence.
integrations.PentaPR: PR continuity gate rejects unreceipted protected overwrites, deletions, and renames.
integrations.PentaMerge: Merge readiness includes PentaSerialized assurance status.
integrations.PentaRelease: Release lineage can serialize immutable release/version/readback facts.
integrations.PentaStatus: Surfaces ledger integrity, tombstones, artifacts, last hash, and gate state.
integrations.PentaGeneration: Receives stable IDs, lineage, archive continuity, snapshots, and recovery history for long-horizon stewardship.

may_not: promote HOLD to PASS without evidence
treat serialization as provider deployment proof
bypass PentaVersion, rights, security, release, or approval gates
